categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Guoke Defence Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: missile (rocket) solid engine power and control products, and ammunition equipment. The missile segment includes solid engine power modules and safety and control modules for missiles and rockets. The ammunition segment covers main ammunition, special ammunition, fuzes, and intelligent control products, with applications in air defense, anti-missile, armored assault, anti-terrorism, and marine survey. Additionally, the company produces civilian products such as cannon-fired hail suppression and rain enhancement munitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary high-performance composite solid propellant formulations, new composite insulation materials, and high-efficiency manufacturing technologies for solid engine power modules. It has developed advanced fuze technologies including C&R dual-mode composite target detection and composite distance measurement. Production methods emphasize strict military-grade quality control, lean manufacturing, and digitalized design and intelligent manufacturing. The company also integrates military technologies into civilian products and pursues innovation in unmanned long-endurance boosters and intelligent ammunition.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are Chinese military units across various branches, military industrial enterprises, authorized military trade companies, and military research institutions. The company also serves civilian meteorological departments through distributors for its hail suppression munitions. Major end markets include domestic defense modernization programs, military training and exercises, and international military trade. Key customers include military units designated as A, B1, G1, D5, and D1, among others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Jiangxi Province, including Nanchang, Taihe, and De'an. It also actively participates in international military trade markets and defense exhibitions to expand overseas presence. The company’s products are supplied to domestic military and civilian customers across various provinces and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Guoke Defence Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the defense supply chain. It undertakes research, development, and manufacturing of missile solid engine modules and ammunition products, including assembly and final product delivery. The company also engages in entrusted development services for military clients. It maintains close cooperation with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream military and civilian customers, ensuring integrated supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven development, emphasizing R&D in missile solid engine power modules, intelligent ammunition, and fuze technologies. It invests heavily in new propellant formulations, advanced insulation materials, and manufacturing process improvements. The R&D approach combines independent research with collaborations with academic and military research institutions. Future directions include unmanned long-endurance boosters, smart ammunition, low-cost guided rocket systems, and expanding military trade products. The company also pursues military-civil fusion by developing civilian applications of military technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of military products to military units and military industrial customers, sales of civilian products via distributors, and income from entrusted research and development contracts. The company recognizes revenue upon product acceptance or customer receipt confirmation. Military sales dominate the revenue mix, accounting for over 97% of total revenue, with civilian sales and R&D services comprising the remainder.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises engaged in missile solid engine power module research and production, holding a prominent position in the Chinese defense industry. It competes primarily with major state-owned military industrial groups and local military enterprises. Its ammunition segment is recognized as a leading domestic developer of small and medium caliber air defense and special ammunition. The company maintains strategic partnerships with several large military industrial groups and is expanding its presence in international military trade markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 15.78% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 198.7 million, up 41.25%. R&D investment increased by 25.95% to RMB 91.2 million, representing 7.57% of revenue. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.16 billion with stable net assets around RMB 2.28 billion. Despite a temporary cash flow decline due to delayed military payments, adjusted cash flow improved by 10.81%. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding military orders and technological innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies in high-performance solid propellants, innovative insulation materials, and intelligent fuze systems, which provide superior product performance, reliability, and safety. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers a wide range of calibers and applications, meeting diverse military operational needs. The integration of digital design and intelligent manufacturing enhances production efficiency and quality control. The company’s ability to deliver customized, high-value missile and ammunition solutions, combined with strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships, differentiates it in the competitive defense market.
